text:
eli: Quick pulse 4: we're piloting a 'Peer Spotlight' lunchtime nomination clinic next Thu 12:00pm PT. 30m total: 8m overview of the program, 12m live clinic filling nominations together, 10m Q&A. Need a host + someone to handle food pickup. Sign-up here: https://forms.gle/spotlight-pilot (tell us dietary prefs).

maria: I can host the kickoff and do the 8m overview. Would love a co-facilitator for the clinic portion.

kevin: happy to co-facilitate and walk through a few nomination examples. Ill prepare 2 anonymized example stories. Do we want a template for the clinic?

eli: yes please. Keep it informal. Suggested flow:
```
- Welcome + purpose (2m)
- Quick rules & eligibility (2m)
- Live clinic: group fills 4 nominations together (12m)
- Q&A + next steps (4m)
```

rhea: I'll handle comms and can post the calendar invite. Blurb idea: "Bring your lunch and a story 4 learn how to nominate teammates for the Peer Spotlight. Practice writing impactful nominations with our clinic."

tara: People Ops headcount: we can reserve 10 in-person seats and stream the rest. I'll book the small conference room.

finance-bot: Reminder: reimbursable limit per session is $200 for food. Submit receipts to Concur within 30 days.

luis: I can pick up boxed lunches from GreenGrain at 11:45am if needed. Count on me.

kevin: For the demo, I'll bring 2 "before" + "after" nomination drafts so folks see phrasing changes. Also will show how to include impact metrics (e.g., reduced latency by 30%, onboarded 5 teammates).

maria: Great. Can someone draft a 1-paragraph intro for the calendar invite (2-3 lines) by EOD? Rhea?

rhea: On it 4 will drop in a blurb and the Zoom link by tomorrow morning.

eli: Two asks: 1) volunteers to read a nomination aloud during the clinic (helps practice), 2) anyone who can join as an observer to capture questions for the FAQ doc.

maria: I'll read one and take notes for the FAQ.

luis: I'll be an observer and take receipts after pickup.

kevin: Also, should we mention spot award taxability and eligibility briefly? Might avoid surprises.

finance-bot: FAQ note: Spot awards are taxable and reported on the next payroll. Exceptions and thresholds documented in People Ops handbook: /handbook/comp-and-bene/spot-awards.

eli: Perfect. Final checklist: blurb (rhea), 2 example drafts (kevin), room + stream (tara), host & co-host (maria + kevin), food pickup (luis), comms post (rhea). If youre on this thread and prefer not to be included in an in-person headcount, please reply.

maria: Thanks everyone 4 I'll share the shared slide deck link and an editable doc for live nomination drafting by tomorrow.

kevin: One more thing 4 can we add an optional anonymized quote field in the nomination form for people who want to capture teammate voice? I'll open a quick PR to the form.

eli: Yes add it as optional. We'll note anonymized quotes may be used in internal comms.

rhea: Posted promo in #general and pinned the sign-up. Already 6 RSVPs. :tada:

eli: Awesome. Closing note: attendees, please bring one short story (1-2 sentences) about a teammate contribution so we can practice converting it into a nomination. Thanks!
